description: This file defines the EcuParameter interface, which extends EcuData and includes a method to add a ConvertorUpdateListener. It is part of the ECU parameter definition structure within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: EcuParameter
classes.description: An interface representing an ECU parameter with a method to add a convertor update listener.

methods.name: addConvertorUpdateListener
methods.description: Adds a listener that is notified when the convertor updates.
